caption:
Is there a UPI fee from 15 October? Not anymore.

The 0.4% merchant fee on shop payments above ₹2,000 was put on hold on 13 Oct. It will now start after Diwali, on a date still to be announced.
Sending money to a friend stays free at any amount, and shop payments up to ₹2,000 carry no fee.
The fee is charged to the merchant. The government says it isn't meant to be collected from customers.
(Our 12 Oct reel said 15 Oct. That date has now moved.)

Has a shop ever asked you for an extra charge to pay by UPI?

Sources: a national news agency report and a business news report on the deferral (13 Oct 2026).
